changes.correction: Product is keyed by product NDC; the RxNorm concept is a separate ClinicalDrug (key RxCUI), referenced optionally from Product and from DrugInvolvement (which was Ref[Product]).
changes.finding: H6: 64% of NDC records carry no RxCUI, so Product (keyed by RxCUI) conformed 19%.

changes.correction: The rule asks for at least one involvement with role primary suspect, secondary suspect or suspect. AdverseEventReport gains source_system (openfda_e2b, faers_qde) so the provenance of roles is explicit.
changes.finding: H6: openFDA follows ICH E2B, which does not record which suspect is primary; 39% of reports failed.

changes.correction: The middle segment allows 3 or 4 digits.
changes.finding: H6: 17% of recall numbers use 3 digits in the middle segment (for example D-321-2016).

changes.correction: An optional -digits suffix (1 to 3 digits) is allowed.
changes.finding: H6: safety report IDs can carry a -digits version suffix (for example 5801206-7).

changes.correction: safe() canonicalizes \d to [0-9] for every target, Pydantic included; lookarounds and other constructs are still rejected.
changes.finding: H6: 10 of 12 developer-written patterns fell outside the safe subset, most because of \d.

changes.correction: Every string is SafeIdentifier (no control characters) or SafeText (no control characters except tab, LF, CR), enforced in Pydantic, SHACL (sh:not) and a Postgres CHECK. Bounded patterns also emit sh:maxLength.
changes.finding: H6: pySHACL accepts a trailing newline before $, and Postgres cannot store NUL.

changes.correction: They stay pydantic_only for SHACL, and the DDL generates UNIQUE constraints for them.
changes.finding: H6: the two uniqueness constraints were pydantic_only and unenforced in Postgres.

changes.correction: The default DDL has plain foreign keys; a test profile keeps them deferrable. Both are drift-checked.
changes.finding: H6: the DDL used deferrable foreign keys only because the integration probe needed them.
